title: Why do some Dubai bus stops have air conditioning?
note: The shelters, bus, screen, map lines and people are generic drawings. The times on the screen (3, 7, 12 min) are made up.

facts.said: Dubai's roads authority (RTA) sorts its bus shelters into four types by daily riders: main (over 750 a day), secondary (250 to 750), standard (100 to 250), pick up and drop off (under 100).

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, RTA bus shelters (12 Apr 2026)
Dubai Media Office, RTA completes 595 bus shelters in key areas across Dubai (7 Dec 2025)

facts.said: Main stops get an air conditioned waiting area, plus shaded seats outside.

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, RTA bus shelters (12 Apr 2026)
RTA, Completion of 595 bus shelters for public transport users (7 Dec 2025)

facts.said: Quieter stops get shade instead; the air conditioned part is only at main stops.

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, RTA to construct 762 bus shelters in key Dubai areas by 2025 (24 Dec 2023)
Gulf News, RTA unveils hundreds of new bus shelters in Dubai (Dec 2025)

facts.said: The new shelters have a screen with the bus map and timings, and a space kept for wheelchairs.

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, RTA bus shelters (12 Apr 2026)
Dubai Media Office, RTA completes 595 bus shelters in key areas across Dubai (7 Dec 2025)

facts.said: By April 2026, 726 new shelters were finished.

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, RTA bus shelters (12 Apr 2026)
Khaleej Times, Dubai RTA installs 726 bus shelters

facts.said: The bus network carries over 192 million riders a year.
